analyst.summary: Laurus Labs delivered a genuinely strong FY26 (revenue +23% to Rs6,813cr, margins up 6.7 points, profit roughly tripling) as its multi-year pivot from ARV-API dependence toward a CDMO-led model (now serving global majors like Amgen) gains traction, on a clean FDA record with no warning letters or import alerts across its plants. The business quality is real, but the stock trades at an extremely rich ~95-113x trailing earnings and ~97x book -- among the richest multiples in Indian pharma -- pricing in years of flawless execution of a CDMO transition that management itself says will take until FY28-29 to reach even half of revenue. We rate this a Hold per the quant score (we cannot override a quant Hold to Sell), but flag the valuation-versus-execution-track-record gap for portfolio-manager attention.
